title: Run unchanged original tests with Go proxy and Go cargohold together

acceptance_criteria.description: Both Go components run simultaneously with pinned Haskell peers; unchanged original proxy 5 and cargohold 27 assertions all pass.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Exact two candidate source/hash pins, all staged peer executable identities, original XML and validated run receipts, successful owned cleanup; no full-backend-suite claim.

acceptance_criteria.description: Add bounded multi-service selection preserving existing single-service selection and assertions.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Focused selection/identity negatives, existing harness/controller checks, scoped state validation and delegated review. Private synthetic Docker only, no defaults or production changes.

evidence.command: Original 5 proxy and 27 cargohold tests passed in one private environment with both Go services selected; both reports record matching two Go hashes, all nine other staged backend hashes equal qualified Haskell preflight. No skips/errors; cleanup exit zero.

12 runner/controller tests, 32 migration validator tests, fresh image build/preflight, scope and diff checks pass. Existing single-service behavior retained; no assertions/catalogue/service code changes.

handoff: Combined two-Go/Haskell original e2e outcome complete: all 32 pass on exact recorded binary/source tuple, both test backends, owned cleanup zero. Reusable multi-service selector and durable evidence retained; no full backend suite, push or production switch.
